card.name: Interrupting, resuming and room temperature
card.fires_on: Words in dose-handling instructions: 'interrupt', 'resume', 'recovery' after 'until', 'interval' after 'dosing', and 'temperature' after 'room'. They appear in label directions for holding, restarting or preparing a drug.

modes.description: Words about pausing a drug until recovery, then resuming it, or changing the dosing interval.
